conditions.displayName: dispatchSweep logged an error, or its Cloud Scheduler job failed

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="dispatchsweep" AND severity>=ERROR) OR (resource.type="cloud_scheduler_job" AND severity>=ERROR)

documentation.subject: Roadside: dispatch sweep failing
documentation.content:
The every-minute sweep that moves expired offers to the next mechanic (PLAN §11) is failing, so bookings can get stuck in `requested`.

Follow docs/runbooks/dispatch-outage.md: check A3 for stuck bookings first, then the logs of `dispatchSweep`.
